study: Original game inspired by the Strikers 1945 structure (WWII propeller fighters -> covert org -> alien/mecha escalation). Genre-and-structure inspiration only — original ships, names, plot, patterns.
engine: Godot 4.7 GDScript, PORTRAIT 540x960 design (vertical shmup), stretch canvas_items/expand, gl_compatibility, native mobile primary (Android/iOS), web secondary

laws.constants_not_magic: every control/weapon/spawn number is a named const in scripts/feel.gd
laws.growing_battery: each subsystem lands with its suite; done = 2x consecutive green
laws.injectable_input: ALL steering flows through scripts/tilt_source.gd — device sensor OR synthetic feeder; CI never needs a phone

controls.primary: tilt -> plane position: Input.get_gravity() absolute orientation (NEVER integrate raw gyro); blend a touch of get_gyroscope() for responsiveness, gravity is the source of truth
controls.mapping: tilt X -> plane X (clamped to bounds); v1 ships LEFT/RIGHT tilt only, fixed auto-scroll
controls.calibration: capture current tilt as neutral on level start + RECENTER tap; stored per session
controls.curve: quadratic response: output = sign(x) * x^2 beyond the dead zone — precise center, fast edges
controls.fallback: touch-drag from day one (setting toggle; also how the editor/emulator plays)
controls.fire: auto-fire always on (tilt owns the hands); tap-anywhere = bomb? no — BOMB is a dedicated on-screen button

powerups.escort_options: orbiting option planes add fire, max 2, tier-gated

milestones: 1 CONTROL PROTOTYPE: tilt abstraction + calibration + dead zone + curve + clamp + touch fallback + synthetic tests
art_direction: top-down WWII-to-sci-fi planes, chunky cartoon-outline sprites, banking sprites (bank_left/bank_right) for tilt readability, parallax sea/cloud tiles per act
